title: MPLADS_Risk_Engine_Feature_Contract
description: Formal feature vector contract for the MPLADS Predictive Risk Scoring Engine.

features.name: delay_days
features.formula: (actual_completion_date - expected_completion_date) if completed else max(0, as_of_date - expected_completion_date)
features.imputation_strategy: 0 for active works within schedule window
features.predictive_rationale: Primary temporal slippage metric. Quantifies schedule overrun beyond contractual milestones to forecast abandonment risk.

features.name: utilization_ratio
features.imputation_strategy: 0.0 when released amount is 0 or unrecorded
features.predictive_rationale: Fund absorption velocity. Stalled projects exhibit zero or negligible absorption despite fund disbursement.

features.name: cost_per_category
features.imputation_strategy: Overall dataset median cost if sector is unmapped
features.predictive_rationale: Peer group baseline. Serves as denominator to detect budget inflation or under-estimation relative to typical asset types.

features.name: progress_gap
features.imputation_strategy: 0.0 if milestone timeline dates are missing
features.predictive_rationale: Direct execution drag indicator. High positive gap (>20%) signals that physical progress is critically lagging elapsed contract time.

features.name: cost_deviation
features.predictive_rationale: Financial cost overrun metric in absolute currency. Quantifies budgetary deficits and contractor claim variances.

features.name: project_duration
features.formula: max(0, (actual_completion if completed else ref_date) - start_date)
features.imputation_strategy: Elapsed duration to reference date if completion date is missing
features.predictive_rationale: Total lifespan to date. Older active projects accumulate exponential stalling probability due to contractor turnover or site disputes.

features.name: cost_relative_to_category
features.predictive_rationale: Normalized capital intensity index. Proposals exceeding 1.5x of the sector norm face higher procurement scrutiny and cost risks.

features.name: sanction_sla_delay_days
features.predictive_rationale: Statutory bureaucratic friction. Projects that breached the 75-day district sanction SLA correlate with poor inter-agency coordination.

features.name: progress_gap_fin_phy
features.predictive_rationale: Financial-to-physical divergence. When fund disbursement exceeds physical milestone delivery by >15%, flags leakage or premature billing.

features.name: unreleased_allocation
features.predictive_rationale: Funding pipeline backlog. High unreleased allocations starve contractor cash flows, directly inducing work stoppages.

features.name: planned_duration_days
features.predictive_rationale: Contractual timeline scope. Multi-year complex civil works have higher systemic vulnerability to inflation and contractor default.

input_validation_schema.description: Type-safe, validated feature vector passed into the future ML/heuristic risk scoring engine.

delay_days.description: Schedule delay in calendar days (positive = late, negative = early)
delay_days.title: Delay Days

cost_per_category.description: Developmental sector benchmark cost in INR
cost_per_category.title: Cost Per Category

project_duration.description: Realized or current elapsed duration in days
project_duration.title: Project Duration

sanction_sla_delay_days.description: Days exceeded beyond statutory 75-day sanction SLA
sanction_sla_delay_days.title: Sanction Sla Delay Days

unreleased_allocation.description: Committed funds awaiting release in INR
unreleased_allocation.title: Unreleased Allocation

is_delayed.description: Flag indicating project is behind schedule
is_delayed.title: Is Delayed

is_schedule_lagging.description: Flag indicating physical progress lags schedule timeline
is_schedule_lagging.title: Is Schedule Lagging

is_disbursement_skewed.description: Flag indicating financial disbursement exceeds physical delivery
is_disbursement_skewed.title: Is Disbursement Skewed

has_cost_overrun.description: Flag indicating cost overrun above sanctioned ceiling
has_cost_overrun.title: Has Cost Overrun

input_validation_schema.title: RiskEngineFeatureVector
